_comment: Reviewed flags for the whole-lockfile audit (#749, agents/build/check_deps_existence.py rules 6-8). A flag passes only when an entry here names its package and rule (and, for a maintainer change or a new package, the exact people added) with a reason and a review date. Existence and lockfile-source failures can never be reviewed. This copy is the factory's: the build loop and the dashboard job read it, never a file in an app's workspace, so the build assistant cannot review its own packages. house-starter carries the same entries in scripts/deps-reviewed.json for the template's and every app's CI. Add an entry only after reading the package's registry record, in a reviewed pull request.

reviewed.reason: `node install.js` selects the platform binary from esbuild's own @esbuild/* optional packages (same publisher, evanw). Used by tsx, vite and drizzle-kit.
`node postinstall.js` checks that SWC's own platform binary (@swc/core-* optional packages) loaded. Dev only, through @vitejs/plugin-react-swc.
`node-gyp rebuild` of the macOS file-watch binding. Optional and os: darwin only, so it is never installed on the Linux runners or the build container. Dev only.
`node postinstall.js` checks its own prebuilt binary (@unrs/resolver-binding-* optional packages). Dev only, through eslint-config-next's import resolver.
